theorems.name: Submission.p06_9e0f5043ff_fno_irreducible_aeval
theorems.statement: ∀ (K F : Type*) [Field K] [Field F] [Algebra K F] (x : F), Transcendental K x → ∀ q : Polynomial K, q.Monic → Irreducible q → ∀ v : AlgebraicCurve.Place K F, (∀ f : F, f ∈ v.toValuationSubring ↔ ∃ a b : Polynomial K, ¬ q ∣ b ∧ f = Polynomial.aeval x a / Polynomial.aeval x b) → ∃ π : v.toValuationSubring, (π : F) = Polynomial.aeval x q ∧ Irreducible π
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
